hypothesis: Skin-bound tapered lashes and a narrow wet mucosal region reduce the bare plastic-eye appearance without changing skin or globe geometry.

wetline.method: Smooth point-domain material mask on original skin; no duplicate/floating surface or new rim volume.

remainingLimits: Caruncle volume not sculpted; do not count rim colour as a caruncle.
No blink or facial keys; lash binding must be regenerated or deformed with the skin when added.
Brow fibres, skin maps and head hair still absent.
Runtime and continuous animation collisions not tested.

localAppearanceEstimate.reason: Visible fibre variation is an improvement, but the result remains sparse, excessively fine and pale in side light; clump pattern and similar curls are still procedural. It is below the 80-point release threshold. This is a subjective evidence-based estimate, not an objective realism metric.

collisionEvidenceScope: Five sampled static poses, not blinking or continuous motion. Body and original optical geometry/deform weights match r0009; closed-solid body/eye proof inherited through r0009 saved verification.
semanticRegionExportNote: AFN10_EyelidWetlineRegion is a non-deforming semantic vertex group. Exporters must map only actual rig-bone groups as skin weights; the wetline also exists as a point-domain shader attribute.
